Entry Crisis Response of the Wall and Free Folk When facing crises on the Great Wall and outside the Great Wall, the most reliable ones are not the legendary heroes, but the long-established way of survival. In times of crisis, old grudges will hinder cooperation, and they will also be forced to reassess by greater coldness and common threats; this also determines who the locals will be. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
